QF.id: I Codes of Conduct and Investor Protection_9

answer.text: A SEBI portal used by investors to escalate and lodge complaints after earlier avenues have been tried
A system for scoring broker performance
A credit scoring system for margin purposes

explanation.text: The Logic: SCORES (SEBI Complaints Redress System) is the SEBI portal through which investors escalate and lodge complaints when grievances are not resolved at the intermediary level. The Trap: SCORES is a complaint-escalation portal, not a broker performance ranking, an order-matching system, or a credit-scoring tool. Note: Investor disputes with listed companies and specified intermediaries can also be taken to the separate ODR (Online Dispute Resolution) portal, which offers status tracking through the dispute lifecycle.
